From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zephyrcorp.com>

Cc: Zephyr Cloud Security <security@zephyrcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ telemetry items for vendor integration - initial ask

Hi Olga / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our CSA engagement we need to map a subset of CAIQ controls to runtime telemetry/evidence for the upcoming technical review. I've attached an initial spreadsheet with the controls we care about (runtime isolation, key rotation, runtime telemetry, and anomaly detection).

Can you provide:
- sample telemetry exports that demonstrate request traces and node-level isolation (anonymized)
- a short description of where KV/cache artifacts are stored and how prefix caching is scoped per tenant
- evidence of key rotation cadence and KMS integration (an excerpt is fine)
- confirmation of log retention windows and how retrieval works for e-discovery requests

Ideally we'd get the artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-13). If any of this needs redaction or PO/contract gating, flag it and we'll escalate on our side.

Attachment: zephyr_caiq_questions_v1.xlsx

Best,
Rajiv
Director, Cloud Security
ZephyrCloud

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zephyrcorp.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ telemetry items for vendor integration - initial ask

Hi Rajiv — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide the artifacts you requested but want to confirm a couple of points to avoid over-sharing:

1) Sample telemetry: we'll provide anonymized request traces and a sanitized node/host sample that preserves request IDs but strips tenant identifiers. Is that acceptable for your audit team?
2) KV/cache scoping: we'll prepare a short diagram + narrative explaining tenant-aware prefixing and eviction semantics; that will point to the specific controls in the CAIQ spreadsheet.
3) Key rotation: we can supply a rotation excerpt and KMS integration diagram; full audit logs require an approved evidence transfer request (PO or confidentiality addendum).
4) Retention: default app runtime logs are retained 90 days; longer retention for audit windows requires an export and signed agreement.

Plan: Marcus will assemble telemetry samples and the anonymization steps; Priya will pull the KMS rotation excerpt; Jonas will add the runtime isolation narrative and the diagram. We'll upload everything to a shared drive and send a secure link.

We aim to have the initial package to you by 2026-05-14 EOD. If Zephyr needs anything earlier or specific formats (CSV vs JSON), let us know.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Next steps: confirm whether the redaction level in the included README satisfies your audit team or if you prefer token-level substitution instead of full tenant masking. Also let us know whether we should proceed with the evidence transfer request for the KMS logs (I can open the ticket).
